entities.summary: Syed Adnan Kakakhail (b. 1975-09-27, Ziarat Kaka Sahib) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ziarat Kaka Sahib and Pakistan. Known in the fields of pakistan, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
